# WPAL Api reference

The designed API (PHP 8.4+). Start with `new Merkushin\Wpal\Wpal()`; see the [README](../README.md) for an overview.

## Wpal

`final class Merkushin\Wpal\Wpal`

Entry point to WPAL's Api layer (PHP 8.4+).

```php
$wp = new Wpal();
$wp->hooks()->onAction( 'init', fn () => ... );
```

In tests, pass fakes for the services you use, e.g. `new Wpal( options: new FakeOptions() )`. Services you don't
pass are built on ServiceFactory, so `ServiceFactory::set_custom_*()` doubles apply to them too.

This file stays PHP 7.4-compatible so older PHP gets a clear error instead of a parse error.

- `hooks(): Hooks`
- `options(): Options`
- `assets(): Assets`
- `posts(): Posts`
- `abilities(): Abilities`
- `ai(): Ai`

## Api\Abilities

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Abilities`

The Abilities API: what the site can do, described so AI agents, the REST API and other plugins can discover and run
it.

Registration timing is handled for you: define and register abilities whenever your plugin loads.

- `define( string $name ): Ability`  
  Starts describing an ability; finish with register().
- `register( Ability $ability ): void`  
  Registers a described ability, now or when WordPress starts registering abilities.
- `registerCategory( string $slug, string $label, string $description, array $meta = [] ): void`  
  Registers a category abilities can belong to, now or when WordPress starts registering categories.
- `has( string $name ): bool`
- `find( string $name ): ?AbilityInfo`
- `get( string $name ): AbilityInfo`  
  Throws `AbilityNotFound`.
- `all( ?string $category = null ): list<AbilityInfo>`
- `execute( string $name, mixed $input = null ): mixed`  
  Runs an ability as the current user: checks permission, validates the input, executes.  
  Throws `AbilityNotFound`; `WordPressError` when permission is denied, the input is invalid, or the ability fails.
- `unregister( string $name ): void`

## Api\Ai

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Ai`

The site's AI provider, through WordPress's AI Client.

- `isAvailable(): bool`

- `prompt( string $text = '' ): Prompt`  
  Starts a prompt; finish with generateText() or generateJson().
- `supports( Prompt $prompt ): bool`
- `generateText( Prompt $prompt ): string`

- `generateJson( Prompt $prompt, ?array $schema = null ): array<mixed>`

## Api\Assets

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Assets`

Scripts and stylesheets.

- `script( string $handle ): Script`  
  Starts describing a script; finish with register() or enqueue().
- `style( string $handle ): Style`  
  Starts describing a stylesheet; finish with register() or enqueue().
- `registerScript( Script $script ): void`
- `enqueueScript( Script $script ): void`  
  Registers the script if it has a source, then enqueues it.
- `registerStyle( Style $style ): void`
- `enqueueStyle( Style $style ): void`  
  Registers the stylesheet if it has a source, then enqueues it.
- `isScriptEnqueued( string $handle ): bool`
- `isStyleEnqueued( string $handle ): bool`
- `dequeueScript( string $handle ): void`
- `dequeueStyle( string $handle ): void`

## Api\Hooks

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Hooks`

Actions and filters.

Callbacks receive as many hook arguments as they declare parameters, so there is no `$accepted_args`.

- `onAction( string $hook, callable $callback, int $priority = 10 ): Subscription`  
  Runs `$callback` whenever `$hook` fires. Lower priorities run first.
- `onFilter( string $hook, callable $callback, int $priority = 10 ): Subscription`  
  Passes `$hook`'s value through `$callback`, which must return the (possibly changed) value.
- `doAction( string $hook, mixed ...$args ): void`
- `applyFilters( string $hook, mixed $value, mixed ...$args ): mixed`
- `didAction( string $hook ): int`  
  How many times `$hook` has fired during this request.
- `hasAction( string $hook ): bool`  
  Whether any callback is attached to action `$hook`.
- `hasFilter( string $hook ): bool`  
  Whether any callback is attached to filter `$hook`.

## Api\Options

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Options`

Site options (`get_option()` and friends).

WordPress returns `false` for a missing option; here a missing option returns your default instead.
WordPress stores scalars as strings, so the typed getters convert: `'1'` is `true` for bool(), `'42'` is `42` for int().

- `get( string $name, mixed $default = null ): mixed`  
  The stored value, or `$default` when the option doesn't exist.
- `has( string $name ): bool`
- `string( string $name, string $default = '' ): string`  
  `$default` when missing or not a scalar.
- `int( string $name, int $default = 0 ): int`  
  `$default` when missing or not numeric.
- `bool( string $name, bool $default = false ): bool`  
  Understands `true`/`false`, `1`/`0`, `'yes'`/`'no'`, `'on'`/`'off'`; `$default` for anything else.
- `array( string $name, array $default = [] ): array<mixed>`
- `set( string $name, mixed $value, ?bool $autoload = null ): void`  
  Creates or updates the option.
- `add( string $name, mixed $value, ?bool $autoload = null ): bool`  
  Creates the option unless it exists.
- `delete( string $name ): bool`

## Api\Posts

`interface Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Posts`

Posts of every type: posts, pages, attachments and custom post types.

- `find( int $id ): ?Post`
- `get( int $id ): Post`  
  Throws `PostNotFound`.
- `query(): PostQuery`  
  Starts a query; by default the 10 newest published posts.
- `matching( PostQuery $query ): list<Post>`
- `create( string $title = '', string $content = '', string $type = 'post', string $status = 'draft', string $excerpt = '', ?string $slug = null, ?int $authorId = null, ?int $parentId = null, int $menuOrder = 0, array $meta = [] ): Post`  
  Throws `WordPressError`.
- `update( int $id, ?string $title = null, ?string $content = null, ?string $status = null, ?string $excerpt = null, ?string $slug = null, ?int $authorId = null, ?int $parentId = null, ?int $menuOrder = null, ?array $meta = null ): Post`  
  Changes only the fields you pass.  
  Throws `PostNotFound`; `WordPressError`.
- `trash( int $id ): void`  
  Moves the post to the trash (or deletes it when trash is disabled, as WordPress does).  
  Throws `PostNotFound`; `WordPressError`.
- `delete( int $id ): void`  
  Deletes the post permanently, skipping the trash.  
  Throws `PostNotFound`; `WordPressError`.

## Api\Abilities\Ability

`final class Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Abilities\Ability`

An ability to register: something the site can do that agents, the REST API and other plugins can discover and run.

```php
$wp->abilities()->define( 'my-plugin/summarize-post' )
    ->label( 'Summarize post' )
    ->description( 'Returns a one-paragraph summary of a post.' )
    ->category( 'content' )
    ->input( [ 'type' => 'object', 'properties' => [ 'id' => [ 'type' => 'integer' ] ], 'required' => [ 'id' ] ] )
    ->output( [ 'type' => 'string' ] )
    ->readonly()
    ->requireCapability( 'read_post' )
    ->execute( fn ( array $input ): string => summarize( $input['id'] ) )
    ->register();
```

| Property | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$label` | `string` |  |
| `$description` | `string` |  |
| `$category` | `string` |  |
| `$inputSchema` | `array<string, mixed>` | JSON Schema of the input; empty when the ability takes none. |
| `$outputSchema` | `array<string, mixed>` | JSON Schema of the result. |
| `$execute` | `(Closure(mixed): mixed)\|null` |  |
| `$permission` | `(Closure(mixed): bool)\|null` |  |
| `$capability` | `?string` | Capability the current user needs, checked when no permission callback is given. |
| `$readonly` | `?bool` | Doesn't change anything. Null when unknown. |
| `$destructive` | `?bool` | May delete or overwrite data. Null when unknown. |
| `$idempotent` | `?bool` | Repeating it with the same input has no further effect. Null when unknown. |
| `$public` | `bool` | Meant to be offered to external consumers such as agents. |
| `$showInRest` | `bool` |  |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>` |  |
| `$name` | `string` | |

- `label( string $label ): self`
- `description( string $description ): self`
- `category( string $category ): self`
- `input( array $schema ): self`
- `output( array $schema ): self`
- `execute( callable $callback ): self`  
  What the ability does. Receives the validated input; returns the result. Throwing fails the run.
- `permission( callable $callback ): self`  
  Who may run it. Receives the input; returns whether the current user may run it.
- `requireCapability( string $capability ): self`  
  Only users with `$capability` may run it. A shortcut for permission().
- `readonly( bool $readonly = true ): self`
- `destructive( bool $destructive = true ): self`
- `idempotent( bool $idempotent = true ): self`
- `public( bool $public = true ): self`  
  Offer it to external consumers such as AI agents.
- `showInRest( bool $show = true ): self`
- `meta( array $meta ): self`
- `register(): void`  
  Registers it now if abilities are being registered, otherwise as soon as WordPress starts registering them.  
  Throws `InvalidArgumentException` when a required part is missing.

## Api\Ai\Prompt

`final class Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Ai\Prompt`

A prompt for the site's configured AI provider. Configure it, then generate.

```php
$summary = $wp->ai()->prompt( "Summarize:\n\n{$post->content}" )
    ->system( 'You write one-paragraph summaries.' )
    ->maxTokens( 200 )
    ->generateText();
```

| Property | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$texts` | `list<string>` |  |
| `$system` | `?string` |  |
| `$temperature` | `?float` |  |
| `$maxTokens` | `?int` |  |
| `$models` | `list<string>` | Model IDs in order of preference. |
| `$provider` | `?string` |  |

- `text( string $text ): self`  
  Adds text to the message.
- `system( string $instruction ): self`
- `temperature( float $temperature ): self`
- `maxTokens( int $maxTokens ): self`
- `models( string ...$models ): self`  
  Preferred models, best first; WordPress uses the first one available.
- `provider( string $provider ): self`
- `isSupported(): bool`  
  Whether the site's AI setup can generate text for this prompt.
- `generateText(): string`  
  Throws `WordPressError` when generation fails or no provider is configured.
- `generateJson( ?array $schema = null ): array<mixed>`  
  Asks for JSON and decodes it.  
  Throws `WordPressError` when generation fails or the response isn't JSON.

## Api\Assets\Script

`final class Merkushin\Wpal\Api\Assets\Script`

A script to register or enqueue. Configure it, then call register() or enqueue().

```php
$wp->assets()->script( 'my-app' )->src( $url )->deps( 'wp-element' )->defer()->enqueue();
```

| Property | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$handle` | `non-empty-string` |  |
| `$src` | `non-empty-string\|null` |  |
| `$deps` | `list<non-empty-string>` |  |
| `$version` | `string\|false\|null` | WordPress's version when false (its default), none when null. |
| `$inFooter` | `bool` |  |
| `$strategy` | `?LoadingStrategy` |  |
| `$inline` | `array<int, array{code: string, position: InlinePosition}>` |  |
| `$translationDomain` | `?string` | Text domain and optional path for wp_set_script_translations(). |
| `$translationPath` | `?string` |  |

- `src( string $url ): self`  
  Throws `InvalidArgumentException` when `$url` is empty.
- `deps( string ...$handles ): self`  
  Throws `InvalidArgumentException` when a handle is empty.
- `version( ?string $version ): self`
- `inFooter( bool $inFooter = true ): self`
- `defer(): self`
- `async(): self`
- `inline( string $code, InlinePosition $position = InlinePosition::After ): self`
- `data( string $name, array $data ): self`  
  Makes `$data` available to the script as the global `$name`, JSON-encoded safely for a <script> tag. Replaces wp_localize_script(), which turns every value into a string.  
  Throws `JsonException` when `$data` can't be encoded.
- `translations( string $domain, ?string $path = null ): self`
- `register(): void`
- `enqueue(): void`
